english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese verb for forcing sexual activity on someone without consent.
Use this specifically when “violate” means to rape.
Use this specifically when force means sexually violating or raping someone.

examples.english: That man allegedly committed rape against the girl and has been arrested by the police.
examples.traditional: 嗰個男人涉嫌強姦嗰個女仔，已經畀警方拉咗。
examples.jyutping: go2 go3 naam4 jan2 sip3 jim4 koeng4 gaan1 go2 go3 neoi5 zai2 ji5 ging1 bei2 ging2 fong1 laai1 zo2

examples.english: The police accused him of trying to violate a woman.
examples.traditional: 警方指控佢企圖強姦一名女子。
examples.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zi2 hung3 keoi5 kei5 tou4 koeng4 gaan1 jat1 ming4 neoi5 zi2

examples.english: The man used force to rape her.
examples.traditional: 個男人用暴力強姦咗佢。
examples.jyutping: go3 naam4 jan4 jung6 bou6 lik6 koeng4 gaan1 zo2 keoi5
